name: wasapi-exclusive
description: EXPERIMENTAL, UNWIRED native Node addon stub for WASAPI exclusive mode (Windows only). Nothing in bridge/, client/ or engine/cpp requires or loads this package; the server's real WASAPI access stays through bridge/audify.js (RtAudio), which only ever opens WASAPI in shared mode - RtAudio has no exclusive-mode path. Read README.md before building or calling it: opening a device exclusively locks every other program (including bridge/server.js's own shared-mode stream) out of it, so openExclusive() refuses to run until it is wired in for real.
